target_customer: Consumers who want gut health improvements and will pay a monthly subscription for personalized probiotics
problem: Off the shelf probiotics are built for an average gut. Gutgutgoose sequences a customer's stool sample, models which probiotic strains have an open niche to colonize, formulates a custom blend and re-sequences later to check what took hold.
business_model: Consumer subscription (about $93 to $183 per month) with at-home sequencing and a retest, plus a 180 day money-back guarantee

founders.name: Leon Mojarrabi
prior_employers: Unnamed YC company described in the launch post as a $3bn unicorn (four years)
previous_startups: A pharmacy business that the launch post says earns about $4M a year and funds the company
founders.background_notes: YC page says he started university at 14 and focuses on strain-level metabolic modelling. No institution named on the YC page.

founders.name: Anis Mihrshahi
education: Chancellor's Excellence Scholarship in AI and Data Science (institution not named on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he joined in September, co-built the mechanistic algorithm and is a youngest state Math Olympiad champion in Queensland.

competitors.what: At-home gut test with personalized supplement and probiotic recommendations
competitors.traction_then: Established consumer brand; a 2026 review says no peer-reviewed randomized trial of its supplement protocol as of May 2026

competitors.what: Gut test at about $349 with custom probiotics, app and coach
competitors.traction_then: Listed in 2026 comparisons of probiotic-seeking test kits

competitors.what: At-home microbiome testing, CLIA and CAP certified

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs shotgun sequencing partners, strain-level metabolic modelling to predict engraftment and a re-sequencing loop to validate. Sources show the founders claim a mechanistic algorithm but no published validation was found.

defensibility.rationale: Each customer cycle yields baseline, intervention and outcome data, which the launch description pitches as a compounding dataset. Many rivals already sell tests with probiotics, so the model and brand are copyable until the data scale exists.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As of the batch the incumbents sell test plus supplement bundles; none was found copying the re-sequencing verification loop. Outcome is unknown.

market_need_then: Consumer demand for gut health testing is visible in many 2026 comparison guides, while a 2026 review notes scientific doubt about microbiome supplement claims. Early traction reported on the YC page: 20 of 50 attendees at an endometriosis event joined the waitlist.

branding.domain_note: Uses gutgutgoose.com as stated on the company site; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: Not described by any opened source
identity.mascot_or_character: Goose in the name; no mascot description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, benefit-led tagline: Better Gut Health with Personalized Probiotics

branding.community_and_virality: A profile on Bioxconomy covers the founders' story as childhood friends. No merch or fan activity found.

brand_strength.rationale: Playful repeated word name is memorable but no source shows brand-driven traction; company is weeks old.

outcome_analysis: Gutgutgoose is an active Summer 2026 company, so there is no outcome yet. The case for it is a data loop that pays for itself through subscriptions and founders with biology and modelling depth. The risks are scientific proof that strain-level prediction works, crowded personalized probiotic competitors and consumer acquisition cost. No funding beyond the standard YC deal was verified.
notes: Funding: aggregators (VCBacked, CB Insights style listings) report about US$500K pre-seed from Y Combinator, other listings say $700K (likely A$ conversion) or seed. This is the standard YC deal seen only on aggregators, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Outcome search found no news of any shutdown or acquisition. Location conflicts between Queensland and San Francisco. Founder institutions and ages appear in secondary coverage that was not opened, so they are left null. Update: the $500K YC standard deal (VCBacked dates it 2026-09, calls it pre-seed; Business News Australia confirms the $500K standard deal) is recorded as stage other; stage labels and dates vary by aggregator.
